from runtime import WorldSpec, Scene, Condition as C, Effect as E, Rule
from runtime import observe, tell, transfer
import random


def build(seed: int) -> WorldSpec:
    rng = random.Random(seed)

    swapped = rng.choice([False, True])
    noor_plain = rng.choice([False, True])
    has_scale = rng.choice([True, False])
    has_plate = rng.choice([True, False])
    generous = rng.choice([True, False])
    pip_priority = rng.choice(["taste", "ownership", "promise"])

    entities = {
        "ada": {"name": "Ada", "kind": "child"},
        "pip": {"name": "Pip", "kind": "animal"},
        "noor": {"name": "Noor", "kind": "person"},
        "mara": {"name": "Mara", "kind": "person"},
        "stall": {"name": "market stall", "kind": "place"},
        "tray": {"name": "baking tray", "kind": "prop"},
        "basket": {"name": "shared basket", "kind": "prop"},
        "label": {"name": "paper label", "kind": "prop"},
        "scale": {"name": "small scale", "kind": "prop"},
        "plate": {"name": "tasting plate", "kind": "prop"},
        "nut": {"name": "nut bun", "kind": "prop"},
        "berry": {"name": "berry bun", "kind": "prop"},
        "plain": {"name": "plain bun", "kind": "prop"},
    }

    nut_label = "berry" if swapped else "nut"
    berry_label = "nut" if swapped else "berry"
    noor_need = "plain" if noor_plain else "berry"

    initial = {
        "ada.location": "stall",
        "pip.location": "stall",
        "noor.location": "stall",
        "mara.location": "stall",
        "tray.location": "stall",
        "basket.location": "stall",
        "label.location": "tray",
        "scale.location": "stall",
        "plate.location": "stall",
        "nut.location": "tray",
        "berry.location": "tray",
        "plain.location": "tray",
        "nut.filling": "nut",
        "berry.filling": "berry",
        "plain.filling": "plain",
        "nut.owner": "mara",
        "berry.owner": "mara",
        "plain.owner": "mara",
        "nut.label": nut_label,
        "berry.label": berry_label,
        "plain.label": "plain",
        "label.accurate": not swapped,
        "scale.available": has_scale,
        "plate.available": has_plate,
        "mara.generous": generous,
        "mara.permission": False,
        "ada.memes.Curiosity": 1,
        "ada.memes.Care": 1,
        "ada.memes.Ambition": 1,
        "pip.memes.Pride": 2,
        "noor.hungry": True,
        "noor.need": noor_need,
        "pip.priority": pip_priority,
        "pip.promise": True,
        "pip.claimed": False,
        "ada.knows.nut.filling": None,
        "ada.knows.berry.filling": None,
        "ada.knows.plain.filling": None,
        "ada.knows.noor.need": None,
        "ada.knows.label.accurate": None,
        "mara.knows.label.accurate": not swapped,
        "pip.knows.nut.filling": None,
        "noor.knows.need": noor_need,
        "nut.final": False,
        "berry.final": False,
        "plain.final": False,
        "stall.sign": "mixed",
        "exchange.success": False,
        "exchange.fair": False,
    }

    scenes = [
        Scene(
            "inspect_label", "observation", ("ada", "label", "tray"),
            (C("ada.location", "eq", "stall"), C("label.location", "eq", "tray"),
             C("ada.memes.Curiosity", "ge", 1)),
            (E("ada.knows.label.accurate", True, "copy"),
             E("ada.memes.Curiosity", 1, "inc")),
            "Ada inspected the paper label beside the tray",
        ),
        observe(
            "inspect_nut", "ada", "nut.filling",
            requires=(C("ada.location", "eq", "stall"),
                      C("nut.location", "eq", "tray"),
                      C("ada.memes.Curiosity", "ge", 1)),
            summary="Ada inspected the nut bun"
        ),
        observe(
            "inspect_berry", "ada", "berry.filling",
            requires=(C("ada.location", "eq", "stall"),
                      C("berry.location", "eq", "tray"),
                      C("ada.memes.Curiosity", "ge", 1)),
            summary="Ada inspected the berry bun"
        ),
        observe(
            "inspect_plain", "ada", "plain.filling",
            requires=(C("ada.location", "eq", "stall"),
                      C("plain.location", "eq", "tray"),
                      C("ada.memes.Curiosity", "ge", 1)),
            summary="Ada inspected the plain bun"
        ),
        Scene(
            "taste_nut", "observation", ("ada", "nut", "plate"),
            (C("plate.available", "eq", True), C("nut.location", "eq", "tray"),
             C("ada.memes.Curiosity", "ge", 1)),
            (E("ada.knows.nut.filling", "nut", "copy"),
             E("ada.memes.Curiosity", 1, "inc")),
            "Ada tasted a permitted crumb from the nut bun",
        ),
        Scene(
            "weigh_buns", "observation", ("ada", "scale", "tray"),
            (C("scale.available", "eq", True), C("ada.location", "eq", "stall"),
             C("ada.memes.Curiosity", "ge", 1)),
            (E("ada.knows.label.accurate", True, "copy"),
             E("ada.memes.Ambition", 1, "inc")),
            "Ada compared the buns on the small scale",
        ),
        Scene(
            "claim_bun", "social", ("pip", "nut", "tray"),
            (C("pip.location", "eq", "stall"), C("nut.location", "eq", "tray"),
             C("pip.memes.Pride", "ge", 1)),
            (E("pip.claimed", True), E("pip.knows.nut.filling", "nut")),
            "Pip proudly claimed the nut bun",
        ),
        Scene(
            "ask_noor", "care", ("ada", "noor", "stall"),
            (C("ada.location", "eq", "stall"), C("noor.location", "eq", "stall"),
             C("noor.hungry", "eq", True)),
            (E("ada.knows.noor.need", noor_need, "copy"),
             E("ada.memes.Care", 1, "inc")),
            "Ada asked Noor which bun would be gentle and filling",
        ),
        tell(
            "tell_mara_label", "ada", "mara", "ada.knows.label.accurate",
            requires=(C("ada.knows.label.accurate", "ne", None),),
            summary="Ada told Mara what she learned about the label"
        ),
        Scene(
            "lend_scale", "cooperation", ("mara", "ada", "scale"),
            (C("mara.generous", "eq", True), C("scale.available", "eq", True),
             C("mara.location", "eq", "stall")),
            (E("ada.memes.Ambition", 1, "inc"), E("scale.available", False)),
            "Mara lent Ada the scale for a careful comparison",
        ),
        transfer(
            "lend_plate", "mara", "ada", "plate",
            requires=(C("mara.generous", "eq", True), C("plate.available", "eq", True)),
            summary="Mara lent Ada the tasting plate"
        ),
        Scene(
            "propose_trade", "fairness", ("ada", "pip", "noor", "nut"),
            (C("ada.knows.noor.need", "ne", None), C("pip.claimed", "eq", True),
             C("noor.hungry", "eq", True), C("ada.memes.Care", "ge", 2)),
            (E("pip.promise", False), E("exchange.fair", True),
             E("ada.memes.Ambition", 1, "inc")),
            "Ada proposed a trade that respected Pip's claim and Noor's need",
        ),
        Scene(
            "accept_trade", "cooperation", ("pip", "ada", "noor", "nut"),
            (C("exchange.fair", "eq", True), C("pip.claimed", "eq", True),
             C("nut.owner", "eq", "mara")),
            (E("nut.owner", "pip"), E("berry.owner", "noor"),
             E("noor.hungry", False), E("exchange.success", True),
             E("pip.claimed", False)),
            "Pip accepted a fair exchange and Noor received a suitable bun",
        ),
        Scene(
            "permission_arrange", "cooperation", ("mara", "ada", "tray", "basket"),
            (C("mara.generous", "eq", True), C("ada.memes.Ambition", "ge", 2),
             C("basket.location", "eq", "stall")),
            (E("mara.permission", True), E("ada.memes.Care", 1, "inc")),
            "Mara gave Ada permission to arrange a shared basket",
        ),
        Scene(
            "make_shared_basket", "care", ("ada", "noor", "basket", "plain"),
            (C("mara.permission", "eq", True), C("ada.knows.noor.need", "ne", None),
             C("plain.owner", "eq", "mara"), C("noor.need", "eq", "plain")),
            (E("plain.location", "basket"), E("plain.owner", "noor"),
             E("noor.hungry", False), E("exchange.success", True),
             E("exchange.fair", True)),
            "Ada placed a suitable plain bun in the shared basket for Noor",
        ),
        Scene(
            "correct_sign", "communication", ("mara", "ada", "label", "stall"),
            (C("ada.knows.label.accurate", "eq", False),
             C("mara.knows.label.accurate", "eq", False),
             C("label.location", "eq", "tray")),
            (E("stall.sign", "accurate"), E("label.accurate", True),
             E("exchange.fair", True)),
            "Mara corrected the public sign after checking Ada's evidence",
        ),
        Scene(
            "mark_final_buns", "arrangement", ("ada", "mara", "label", "tray"),
            (C("stall.sign", "eq", "accurate"), C("label.accurate", "eq", True)),
            (E("nut.final", True), E("berry.final", True), E("plain.final", True),
             E("exchange.success", True)),
            "Ada and Mara marked the final buns with accurate labels",
        ),
        Scene(
            "weigh_final", "arrangement", ("ada", "scale", "basket"),
            (C("exchange.success", "eq", True), C("scale.available", "eq", True)),
            (E("exchange.fair", True), E("ada.memes.Ambition", 1, "inc")),
            "Ada weighed the final portions to display a balanced exchange",
        ),
        Scene(
            "announce_stall", "communication", ("ada", "mara", "pip", "noor"),
            (C("exchange.success", "eq", True), C("exchange.fair", "eq", True)),
            (E("stall.sign", "announced")),
            "The group announced the stall's accurate new arrangement",
        ),
    ]

    rules = (
        Rule(
            "owners_are_people",
            (C("nut.owner", "in", ("mara", "ada", "pip", "noor")),
             C("berry.owner", "in", ("mara", "ada", "pip", "noor")),
             C("plain.owner", "in", ("mara", "ada", "pip", "noor")))
        ),
        Rule(
            "noor_gets_suitable_food",
            (C("noor.hungry", "eq", True),)
        ),
        Rule(
            "final_labels_match",
            (C("label.accurate", "eq", True),),
            when=(C("stall.sign", "in", ("accurate", "announced")),)
        ),
    )

    goal = (
        C("exchange.success", "eq", True),
        C("exchange.fair", "eq", True),
        C("stall.sign", "in", ("accurate", "announced")),
    )

    labels = {
        "ada.memes.Curiosity": "Ada's curiosity",
        "ada.memes.Care": "Ada's care",
        "ada.memes.Ambition": "Ada's determination",
        "noor.hungry": "Noor is hungry",
        "exchange.success": "successful exchange",
        "exchange.fair": "fair arrangement",
        "stall.sign": "stall sign",
    }

    return WorldSpec(
        "The Crumb-and-Label Exchange",
        entities,
        initial,
        tuple(scenes),
        goal,
        rules=rules,
        labels=labels,
    )
